name: Voice
overview: The voice of God is depicted in Scripture as powerful and majestic, likened to the noise of great waters and the sound of cherubim wings, emphasizing His divine authority and presence (Ezekiel 1:24, 10:5). It is also a voice that brings revelation and glory, as seen when a voice from heaven affirms the glorification of the Father’s name (John 12:28-29). Yet, the voice of God is not always audibly recognized by all, as Jesus explains that many have neither heard His voice nor seen His form (John 5:37), highlighting the spiritual discernment required to truly perceive God’s communication. Ezekiel’s vision further underscores the reverent response to God’s voice, causing awe and worship (Ezekiel 1:28).
